message: Vector Rebel 3.2.54 adds a Station 4 SCBA Airpacks search and local physical-review draft.
releaseNotes: Adds an independent SCBA Airpacks button to Vector Rebel for Equipment > Standard. The read-only scanner requires the three native location filters: Truck 504 (63000-13), Medic 504 (61000-12), and Station 4 SCBA Supply Room. It paginates native equipment rows, identifies likely airpacks by exact Pool/Name and Location, excludes masks and loose cylinders, groups results, and offers a local inspection draft with user-selected status and native item links. This does not invent an inspection template, change official equipment records, or submit/sign a Vector inspection. Live authenticated field acceptance and official airpack inspection template mapping remain open. All existing PPE safety gates unchanged.
